declarations.name: Tools
declarations.doc: A `tools` kind: `tools()` gives the LangChain tools of its methods with a doc comment (the kind writes it).

declarations.name: WebSocketServer

members.name: instrument
members.doc: Called by configureApp with the Nest app before it starts (the app's WebSocket hooks in here).

members.name: answer
members.doc: One request through the app itself, over the loopback: the same pipeline as an HTTP request.

declarations.doc: The app also answers over a WebSocket at `path` (`'ws'` → `/ws`).

declarations.name: afterCommit
declarations.doc: Inside `@transactional`, keeps `send` for the commit (dropped by a rollback, never run twice by a retry) and answers true; outside one answers false and the caller sends at once.

declarations.name: answerOf

declarations.name: appClient
declarations.doc: The test's app over HTTP and its WebSocket.

declarations.name: cacheGet
declarations.doc: The JSON value cached under `key`, or null.

declarations.name: cacheSet
declarations.doc: Caches `value` as JSON under `key`, for `seconds` (forever without it).

declarations.name: chatModel
declarations.doc: The chat model of the configuration with that name.

declarations.name: checkModel
declarations.doc: Checks a model its constructor was given values for (`NewCustomer(email = "nope")`), as every dialect does. A request's body is not built this way: the validation of the request checks it, once.

declarations.name: columnText
declarations.doc: The text a column keeps of an exact value: a `bigint`'s digits; a `bigdouble` with `scale` decimals (more when the value has more: a value compared, never written, as it is). Of equal values the text

declarations.name: configureApp
declarations.doc: What every Synapsis app has: the edge of every request (its line in the log, the body's limit and type, CORS), validated bodies (class-validator), Result answers, routes whose order does not matter, m

declarations.name: connection
declarations.doc: The open connection of that type and name: connection(Redis), connection(Kafka, 'events').

declarations.name: connections
declarations.doc: The open connections.

declarations.name: createApp
declarations.doc: The Nest app of `module`, configured and remembered for `inject`.

declarations.name: currentApp
declarations.doc: The running app (the tests' appClient).

declarations.name: databaseOf
declarations.doc: The options of the config's database for SequelizeModule.forRoot (the first Database, or the named one).

declarations.name: env
declarations.doc: The environment variable `name`, or `fallback`.

declarations.name: errorBody
declarations.doc: The body of an error; `errors` keeps one reason per field, in the order of the fields' names.

declarations.name: exactColumn
declarations.doc: The options of an exact column of an entity (`@Column({ type: DataType.DECIMAL(30, 10), ...exactColumn('price', 30, 10) })`): the value is read back as the exact number (a `bigint`, a BigDouble) and k

declarations.name: exactText
declarations.doc: The text an exact value is kept as (`defaultValue: exactText(BigDouble.of('1.5'), 10)`).

declarations.name: fitsBigDouble
declarations.doc: Whether a `NUMERIC(precision, scale)` holds `d` exactly: at most `scale` decimals and `precision - scale` digits before the point (the databases would round the decimals away).

declarations.name: guardedBy
declarations.doc: `@controller('admin', guards = [...])`: every route of the controller passes them.

declarations.name: headersOf
declarations.doc: A request's headers with every value it was given (Node joins or drops a header sent twice).

declarations.name: inject
declarations.doc: The instance Nest built of `cls` (the app must be running).

declarations.name: isWhole
declarations.doc: A whole number within 64 bits (an `int` of the platform, the reference §2.3): beyond it, a number is not of the type. Its name is the validator's `isInt`, so its reason is the type's.

declarations.name: joinPath
declarations.doc: `character` and `:id` → `character/:id` (no doubled slashes).

declarations.name: joinTable
declarations.doc: The options of a `@manyToMany`: the join table `name` with only its two columns (no timestamps, as SQLAlchemy's), `foreignKey` pointing to this side and `otherKey` to the other.

declarations.name: mustRetry
declarations.doc: The database refused the transaction only because of another one running at the same time: running it again may succeed. Any other error is not retried.

declarations.name: parseBigDouble
declarations.doc: `text.toBigDouble()`: the exact decimal of `text`, or null; also null past MAX_DIGITS digits (counted before the value is made: `1e999999999` would be a billion digits).

declarations.name: parseBigInt
declarations.doc: `text.toBigInt()`: the whole number of `text`, or null; also null past MAX_DIGITS digits.

declarations.name: publish
declarations.doc: Sends `value` (a model, an object, a text) to the topic. Inside `@transactional` it is sent after the commit, and not at all when the transaction is rolled back.

declarations.name: reason
declarations.doc: A reason with its message, written here so every dialect says the same.

declarations.name: reasonsOf
declarations.doc: The reasons of the validator's errors, in Nuclear's words.

declarations.name: refusal
declarations.doc: The first guard that refuses the request, in order, or null.

declarations.name: register
declarations.doc: Adds an open connection (tests: a FakeModel), replacing one of the same class and name.

declarations.name: sinks
declarations.doc: Who else receives every event this process publishes (the app's WebSocket, synapsis-nest/sockets).

declarations.name: splitParams
declarations.doc: The URL path with its `:name` parameters put in, the query and the JSON body.

declarations.name: textOf
declarations.doc: The text of a model's answer.

declarations.name: transactional

declarations.name: useApp
declarations.doc: Remembers an app built elsewhere (the testing module) for `inject`.

declarations.name: useConnection
declarations.doc: Puts `connection` in the app's connections (a FakeModel instead of the configured model).

declarations.name: vectorStore
declarations.doc: The vector store of the configuration with that name (a LangChain VectorStore).
